pages.title: Made to Order
pages.text: Each bed belongs to one character and cannot be claimed twice. Stand one in a room of the matching house and that character takes it as hers. You cannot sleep in it, and it is not your respawn point either.
$(bold)What they do$()$(br)Right-clicking a bed does nothing at all. Once a character has claimed one, she sleeps in it through the night, and works as her respawn point.
